body: Research break requested by user completed; details and pinned source links in docs/runtime-capabilities.md. Mount & Warcraft author confirms custom Azeroth map on matching 1.4.8/1.2.8 versions, but no public runtime world-generation source located. TAOM and Alliance source both lock editable mesh data and pass its handle during triangle insertion; our grid used zero. Controlled lock-only trial built and deployed for PID17972; untested scene-name ordering change reverted. Prior PID30472 passed input then crashed; PID4408 crashed before deferred collision registration, ruling those changes out as solutions. Custom Scene Creator source uses two pre-indexed scene slots and file-side navmesh bakes, independently matching our indexed-file reload evidence. This is the preferred alternative architecture to investigate; arbitrary terrain.bin generation remains unproven. Official War Sails docs identify required naval region types, flowmap, custom water entities and settlement cache regeneration. No campaign/backend ticket accepted.
